image: # The four warlords' duel sprites, made on 2026-11-22 (tools/enemies/raw/, built by tools/make_enemies.py).
# Each is one of the four candidates of a create_image_pro job, 96x96, no background, with the common warlord
# (assets/sprites/enemy_warlord.png) as both reference and style image. Every request began with "a goblin warlord
# battle sprite in the same style, size and three-quarter pose as the reference warlord, facing left:" and ended
# with "no banner. Dark outline, saturated colours, feet on the bottom edge". Nothing was retouched.

what was asked: Morgash the Wall-Breaker, a massive broad-shouldered green goblin warlord in dark iron plate with a horned helmet, holding a huge two-handed stone war hammer, rubble and a broken brick hanging from his belt

Zhara the Bramble-Mother, a tall lean female green goblin shaman-chief in dark purple robes wrapped in thorny brambles, a crown of thorns and bones, holding a twisted bramble staff topped with a glowing violet crystal, bone charms on her belt

Urgak the Brute-Driver, a very wide heavy green goblin warlord in spiked purple-grey plate armour like a brute, a horned iron helmet, holding a huge butcher's cleaver in one hand and a coiled whip in the other
Skrit the Quick Blade, a lean wiry green goblin duelist-chief in light dark leather armour with a red scarf and a small hood, crouched ready to spring, a short curved blade in each hand
